title: PolyProPicks Automation Hypothesis
description: One supported automation idea produced by a Daily Evolution Review. Enforced by scripts/control-plane/lib/evolution-cycle.mjs.

observed_problem.description: A problem actually observed in the reviewed period. Never speculative.

axis_a_effect.description: Effect on launch, revenue, settlement or reconciled PnL. May be 'none'.

axis_b_effect.description: Effect on reusable Manifest 2 capability. May be 'none'.

persistent_artifact.description: The tracked repository path that would remain in Git afterwards.

implementation_cost.description: Use UNKNOWN or NOT_AVAILABLE when not knowable. Never guess.

x-invariants: Every hypothesis must trace to an observed problem with at least one evidence reference.
persistent_artifact must name a repository path — an idea with no durable artifact is not an automation hypothesis.
Unknown cost is written literally as UNKNOWN or NOT_AVAILABLE, never estimated.
classification NOW does not authorize execution; it is a proposal for the next architect step.
